body:
We tried to be as compatible with Bootstrap 3 as possible while building the app, but we do not have any official support of it. As @vvo suggested, sometimes you can get away with the `cssClasses` options, or defining a 'master' template where you have all control on the markup (but need to do everything yourself). Still, not all our widgets provide this functionality.

A JSFiddle would help fixing your specific problem :)
